text:
katie: FYI — docs generate endpoint mismatch. Example shows stop: ['\n'] but API schema accepts string OR array. Node snippet uses string. Need docs PR. cc @ryan @sam
ryan: ah ok, where exactly? paste snippet or link pls.
katie: Here — current docs snippet:
```js
await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-1',
  prompt: 'translate...',
  stop: ['\n','###']
})
```
Runtime accepts string|array but SDK behavior differs, tests failing. Filed ticket DOCS-412.
sam: I can update Node snippet + add migration note. Should we standardize examples to arrays (recommended) or keep string for backward compat? @mona thoughts?
mona: migration note + both examples. Wording: "If your SDK < 1.0 pass a single string; >=1.0 supports arrays." Keep example order: recommended first.
luis: also the streaming sample for generate-streaming expects `event: chunk` but runtime emits `event: response` with .delta. I'll fix sample SSE handler.
sam: I'll open PR "docs/stop-array-fix" — update Node & Go snippets, add migration guide, fix SSE handler. ping for reviews.
ryan: :thumbsup: add curl tests showing both string and array behavior; add OpenAPI note: stop: oneOf[string, array[string]]
docs-bot: Created DOCS-412 and assigned sam,luis. PR checklist link: https://redwood.dev/docs-pr-template
